request.gloss: attach the questions

steps.note: One step. A teacher creates a quiz for their own subject and class (BR-2), and the mode is chosen here because a paper quiz and an online one run differently from this point on (BR-3).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A subject the actor does not teach, and a total of zero or less, arrive as errors.
plan.atomicity: One write: the quiz in Draft, with the audit entry. It holds no questions and can be opened by nobody until they are attached (E3). No approval and no release stands between it and use (BR-1).

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No subject matches, or it is not one the actor teaches.

parameters.notes: A subject the acting teacher teaches (BR-2, E1).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

parameters.name: total_marks
parameters.notes: Greater than zero (E2). The teacher's figure.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.notes: How the quiz is held (BR-3). It decides everything that follows — an online quiz runs within a window, a paper one is printed, conducted, marked by hand and uploaded — so it is never assumed.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: questions_count
fields.description: Zero. The quiz cannot be opened until questions are attached (E3).

errors.meaning: The subject is not one the acting teacher teaches.
errors.note: A quiz set by somebody who does not teach the class is not an informal assessment of it (BR-2).

errors.meaning: The total marks are zero or less.

planningRules.rule: Never assume the mode. Online and on paper run differently from creation onwards — one has a window and automatic scoring, the other is printed and marked by hand (BR-3) — and a planner that chose has decided how a class sits it.
Never supply the total marks. It is what every score is measured against (E7), and the teacher's to set.
Say plainly that no approval or release is involved. There is none (BR-1, E9), and somebody expecting the exam path will wait for a step that never comes.
Never describe a quiz result as part of the exam result. It is an informal assessment and is reported as one (BR-10).
session_id and branch_id come from $session.

reversal.statement: A quiz is never deleted once attempted; it is closed and its results stay on the record (BR-11, E10). An unattempted draft is simply left unused.
